title: Lamb Roast with Roasted Vegetables
description: A classic lamb roast recipe with a delicious crispy crust and flavorful roasted vegetables.
instructions: Season the lamb roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the Norwegian oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue roasting for 15-20 minutes per kilogram, or until the lamb reaches your desired level of doneness.
Toss the krispy potatoes and roast carrots with a little oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet.
Roast the potatoes and carrots in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and golden brown.
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before carving and serving with the roasted vegetables.
